statusSemantics.functional: Live and evidence-backed in repo + production. UI may claim connected/healthy.
statusSemantics.partial: Real implementation exists but a checklist item is missing (adapter boundary, hardening, live-cert, or dedicated code). UI must not overstate.
statusSemantics.scaffolded: Lifecycle + data-plane wiring + fail-closed gating + tests exist, but no domain workflow or provider credentials. Gate B. UI shows setup-required, never Connected.
statusSemantics.missing: No code, config, or docs in repo. Requires verified provider contract before any work. Must stay out of the installable catalog.
